facts.fact: YouTube (the video platform on TV screens, not the YouTube TV subscription) held 12.7% of total U.S. TV viewing time in January 2026 according to Nielsen's The Gauge.
facts.quote: In January 2026, YouTube (the video platform on TV screens, not the YouTube TV subscription) held 12.7% of total U.S. TV viewing time according to Nielsen's The Gauge.

facts.fact: NBCUniversal-Versant reached 13.1% in Nielsen's Media Distributor Gauge in February 2026, surpassing YouTube.
facts.quote: NBCUniversal-Versant (which reached 13.1% in Nielsen's Media Distributor Gauge)

facts.fact: Total streaming share of U.S. TV viewing was 47.0% in January 2026, a record for The Gauge according to Nielsen's press release.
facts.quote: Total streaming share was 47.0% in January 2026 (a record for The Gauge per Nielsen's press release)

facts.fact: Total streaming share of U.S. TV viewing fell to 41.9% in February 2026.
facts.quote: pulled back to 41.9% in February as the tentpole events drew viewers to linear TV

facts.fact: Broadcast share of U.S. TV viewing rose from 21.2% in January 2026 to 21.7% in February 2026.
facts.quote: Broadcast rose from 21.2% in January to 21.7% in February.

facts.fact: Cable share of U.S. TV viewing dropped to 20.0% in February 2026.
facts.quote: Cable dropped to 20.0% in February.

facts.fact: The Winter Olympics ran February 6-22, 2026 on NBC and its affiliated networks.
facts.quote: the Winter Olympics running February 6-22 on NBC and its affiliated networks

facts.fact: Nielsen delayed the March 2026 Gauge report, and MediaPost reported on March 20, 2026 that the recalibrated Gauge was postponed to later in 2026.
facts.quote: MediaPost reported on March 20, 2026 that the recalibrated Gauge has been postponed to later in 2026.

facts.fact: Nielsen's The Gauge launched in 2021 and has been published monthly since.
facts.quote: The Gauge launched in 2021 and has been published monthly since.

facts.fact: Nielsen has paused full implementation of its DASH measurement methodology pending review, and the January and February 2026 Gauge reports use the pre-DASH methodology.
facts.quote: Nielsen has paused full DASH implementation pending review

facts.fact: Adwave states that strong view-through rate on CTV runs 90% or higher because the format doesn't allow skipping on most placements.
facts.quote: Strong VTR on CTV runs 90%+ because the format doesn't allow skipping on most placements.

facts.fact: Adwave says a TV campaign including YouTube starts at $30 a day on its platform.
facts.quote: On [Adwave](https://adwave.com/pricing/), a TV campaign, including YouTube, starts at $30 a day.

facts.fact: Adwave says Google Search campaigns also start at $30 a day.
facts.quote: Google Search also starts at $30 a day.

facts.fact: eMarketer's December 2025 forecast projects roughly $37.95 billion in U.S. CTV advertising spending in 2026.
facts.quote: That shift is driving roughly $37.95 billion in projected U.S. CTV advertising spending in 2026 (eMarketer's December 2025 forecast), up 14.5% year-over-year.

facts.fact: eMarketer's December 2025 forecast projects U.S. CTV advertising spending in 2026 to grow 14.5% year-over-year.
facts.quote: roughly $37.95 billion in projected U.S. CTV advertising spending in 2026 (eMarketer's December 2025 forecast), up 14.5% year-over-year.

facts.fact: eMarketer projects CTV advertising to surpass linear TV advertising by 2028.
facts.quote: eMarketer's forecast also projects CTV advertising to surpass linear TV advertising by 2028.

facts.fact: In January 2026, YouTube held 12.7% of total TV viewing versus Netflix's 9.0%, according to Nielsen's The Gauge.
facts.quote: In January 2026, YouTube held 12.7% of total TV viewing versus Netflix's 9.0%, per Nielsen's The Gauge.

facts.fact: In February 2026, the NBCU-Versant combined share reached 13.1% of total TV viewing, temporarily ahead of YouTube at 12.7%, per Nielsen's The Gauge as cited by Adwave.
facts.quote: NBCU-Versant combined reached 13.1% of total TV viewing for the month, temporarily ahead of YouTube at 12.7%.

facts.fact: The Super Bowl LX aired on NBC on February 8, 2026, and the Milan-Cortina Winter Olympics ran February 6-22 on NBC and its networks.
facts.quote: The Super Bowl LX on NBC (February 8) and the Milan-Cortina Winter Olympics (February 6-22 on NBC and its networks)

facts.fact: Adwave advises that advertisers allocate 30-60 days to measurable results before drawing conclusions from YouTube campaigns.
facts.quote: Allocate 30-60 days to measurable results before drawing conclusions.

facts.fact: Nielsen has delayed the recalibrated Gauge multiple times through early 2026.
facts.quote: Nielsen has delayed the recalibrated Gauge multiple times through early 2026.
